purpose: Phase 2 modeling brief for the 曦境王國 roster expansion. Simulation rules ship behind catalog `preview: true` flags (src/scripts/games/rts/catalog.ts); remove a unit's flag only after its production model is published in the model registry (REQUIRED_MODELS). Existing models must never stand in as placeholders.
faction_style: Same 曦境王國 language as the published guard/crossbow/knight/commander: warm ivory and dawn-gold trims over blue-steel, team colour on tabards and cloth, readable silhouette at RTS camera distance, original designs only.
clip_names: Match the published contract: Idle, Walk, Attack, Hurt, Death; casters add Cast (heroes add one Cast<Skill> clip per skill). Attack contact / projectile release frames must be recorded so catalog PROJECTILE_RELEASE_SECONDS can be locked to them.
new_buildings_note: No new building: 長槍兵/遊俠 train at the barracks, 曦光法師 at the chapel, 獅鷲騎士 at the stable, both new heroes at the altar.

units.name: 長槍兵
units.role: Cheap tier-I line infantry; spear attack deals 1.75x to cavalry (騎士).
units.silhouette: Upright footman taller than the guard because of a 2.6 m pike held vertically at idle; narrow shoulders, no shield.
units.equipment: Long ash pike with a leaf blade and gold collar, open sallet helmet, padded gambeson under a short breastplate, team-colour tabard.
units.rig: Share the guard humanoid rig and LOD scheme; new weapon socket for a two-handed pike grip (guard right-hand cage contract as reference).

units.name: 遊俠
units.role: Fast tier-II ranged scout with long sight (20); hits ground and air.
units.silhouette: Light, lean archer with a hooded half-cape and a longbow taller than the crossbowman's weapon; forward-leaning run.
units.equipment: Recurve longbow, back quiver, leather brigandine, soft boots, team-colour hood lining.
animations: Walk (faster cadence, stride matched to speed 3.7)
Attack (draw and loose; projectile release frame recorded, sim currently 0.4 s)
units.rig: Share the crossbow humanoid rig; new bow weapon and arrow projectile model (reuse the bolt projectile only as a technical reference, not as art).

units.name: 曦光法師
units.role: Tier-II caster at the chapel: magic bolt (hits air) plus autocast 曦光術 area blast that slows.
units.silhouette: Robed figure with a tall sun-disc staff; wide sleeves and a long hem distinguish it from the priest's narrower vestments.
units.equipment: Staff topped with an open gold sun ring, layered ivory robes with blue-steel mantle, team-colour stole.
units.rig: Share the priest humanoid rig; new staff prop. Needs a small ground-burst effect for 曦光術 (radius 2.5 m) in a later effects pass.

units.name: 獅鷲騎士
units.role: Tier-III AIR unit from the stable; flies over terrain, hits ground and air; countered by piercing (1.5x).
units.silhouette: Winged gryphon (eagle fore-body, lion hind-quarters) with a hammer-armed rider; wingspan clearly wider than a knight, hovering 3-4 m above ground.
units.equipment: Rider in a winged helm and light plate with a stormhammer; gryphon barding with team-colour saddle cloth and gold bridle.
units.rig: New creature rig (quadruped + wings) with a rider socket; rider can reuse the knight rider's upper-body rig. Scene must lift the model by a height offset when UNITS[kind].flying is set.

units.name: 曦光賢者
units.role: Caster hero: 曦光爆裂 (area damage), 晨輝療癒 (area heal), 破曉 (level-3 area damage + slow).
units.silhouette: Elder hero in a high-collared mantle with a floating sun halo behind the head; staff longer than the mage's.
units.equipment: Ornate gold-and-ivory staff, layered mantle with dawn-gradient trim, book or reliquary at the belt, team-colour sash.
units.rig: Share the commander hero humanoid rig (hero scale and LOD budget); new staff and halo props.

units.name: 遊俠隊長
units.role: Mobile ranged hero: 箭雨 (area volley), 疾行號令 (area haste), 獵殺標記 (level-3 mark: +25% damage taken).
units.silhouette: Tall cloaked archer hero with a long flowing hooded cloak, falcon feather crest and a large ornate longbow.
units.equipment: Gold-inlaid longbow, twin quivers, leather-and-scale armour, short sword at the hip, team-colour cloak.
animations: Attack (loose; release frame recorded, sim currently 0.4 s)
units.rig: Share the commander hero humanoid rig; bow handling poses can follow the ranger's bow clips.

ui_follow_up: Each unit needs a train icon unit-<kind>.webp and each new hero skill an icon <skill>.png (sunburst, radiance, daybreak, volley, sprint, mark); hud.ts shows text-only buttons for preview units until then. Portrait framing (portrait.ts PORTRAIT_FRAMING) is added with each published model.
